summary: Iteration 41: UI-only regression test after full panel restyle (CSS/className changes only). All critical surfaces render correctly and remain interactive. Ambient layer overlay does NOT block clicks (pointer-events: none, z-index: 0 confirmed). Bento module grid renders on Home for multi-role users with role-based filtering working. Operator, Plan, Warehouse, Bobin, MarkaStok, LiveDashboard panels all load, headers/tabs/dialogs work, logout returns to Home. Mobile (390px) has no overflow, dashboard summary stacks 2-col, bento grid 2-col. No CSS regression breakage detected.
